annotations.title: Generate a text or emoji favicon

description: Build a favicon from one or two characters or an emoji on a colored rounded-square or circle background, with optional dark-mode colors. Returns favicon.svg, the HTML <head> snippet, site.webmanifest, the list of files a site needs, and commands that turn the SVG into favicon.ico and the PNG sizes.

background_end.description: Background gradient end in light mode. Defaults to background_start when that is set, otherwise #ec4899.

background_end_dark.description: Background gradient end in dark mode. Defaults to the light-mode value once any light-mode color is set.

background_start.description: Background gradient start in light mode, or "transparent". Default #6366f1.

background_start_dark.description: Background gradient start in dark mode. Defaults to the light-mode value once any light-mode color is set.

font_family.description: CSS font list, e.g. "'Inter', sans-serif". Emoji default to a color-emoji font list.

font_size.description: Glyph size on a 512-unit canvas. Default 280.

font_weight.description: Font weight in steps of 100. Default 700.

radius.description: Corner radius of the rounded shape on a 512-unit canvas; 0 is a square. Default 104.

short_name.description: Short app name for site.webmanifest (home screen label).

text.description: One or two characters or one emoji, e.g. "A", "JS", "🚀". Default "F".

text_color.description: Glyph color in light mode. Default #ffffff.

text_color_dark.description: Glyph color in dark mode (prefers-color-scheme: dark). Defaults to the light-mode value once any light-mode color is set.

theme_color_dark.description: Browser UI color in dark mode. Default #0f172a.

theme_color_light.description: Browser UI color (<meta name="theme-color">) in light mode. Default #ffffff.

name: generate_text_favicon
title: Generate a text or emoji favicon
